sentences.en: Collimate and coupling technique is the key technology of MOEMS optical array.

sentences.en: International luxury brands collimate Chinese market, luxury-related expositions turn to be China-hosted, and the scale of luxury consumption of China bounded into worldly tops.

sentences.en: An incandescent bulb and fiber were used to collimate light into this speedometer indicator.

sentences.en: The non-spherical lens is another shaping system that is used to collimate the beam of LD, and the theoretic performance could be perfect.

sentences.en: An optical pickup generates spherical aberration in a laser light emitted from a semiconductor laser becoming a light source by moving, in the direction of the optical path, a collimate lens.

sentences.en: By using the light ray vector method, the elliptic-section cylinder lenses have been designed to collimate the semiconductor laser beam.

sentences.en: Today's LEDs have reflector cups and focusing optics to focus and collimate their output.

sentences.en: Dr. Donald Frush, chief of pediatric radiology at the Duke University School of Medicine, said that failing to properly cone, or collimate, the radiation was rare.

sentences.en: To meet the technical requirements of KM6 solar simulator optical adjustment system, two kinds of schemes are put forward to collimate the semiconductor laser beam.
